svg.title: Stacker crane single and dual command cycle with FEM 9.851 reference points P1 and P2 – raw material AS/RS example
svg.text: Stacker crane cycle – single command (SC) and dual command (DC) with FEM 9.851 reference points – ASRS-RAW

Rack face seen from the aisle: 28 m long, top load level 8.0 m above the I/O point. Crane data = example values of §10.2: travel 3 m/s, 0.5 m/s²; hoist 1 m/s, 0.5 m/s²; fork t_LHD = 5 s; fine positioning t_pos = 3 s.
floor rail of the stacker crane (aisle 1.5 m wide)
trapezoid t = s/v + v/a if s ≥ v²/a (travel 18 m, hoist 2 m); else triangle t = 2·√(s/a)
Bozer–White check without acceleration: SC 27.6 s, DC 44.7 s (lower – first estimate only)
Need at 17.2 units/h: raw 20.6 jobs/h → 20 % (SC); FG AS/RS 34.4 jobs/h
Twin config: 50 s (raw) / 60 s (FG) per job – conservative vs. these example crane data.
Accept the real crane by measuring 10 SC + 10 DC to P1/P2 (FEM 9.851) – chapter 5, test 8.
Stacker crane cycle SC / DC – ASRS-RAW
